title: 第3章 觉醒万道神体第4章 以其人之道还治其人之身
content_zh:
葬天塔第一层，沉浮着数之不尽的灰蒙气雾，乃是最为纯净的混沌之气，比之武修所修炼的天地元气不知道要高级多少的至高能量。
此刻，受到莫名牵引，大量的混沌气雾源源不断地冲向秦玄的身躯。
本来秦玄因为那一战，不但丹田被废，而且经脉断裂不少，浑身上下都不知道受到了多少暗伤，就连许多骨骼都有裂痕，甚至断裂了。
一般而言，武修受到了这样的伤害，就算丹田没有破碎，也无法继续提升。
时间一久，潜在的暗伤一旦爆发，会直接要了武修的性命。
但伴随着混沌气雾的入体，顷刻间，便是修复了秦玄体内所有暗伤，包括丹田也在顷刻间修复完整。
并且肉身发生了前所未有的变化，正在不断地淬炼蜕变。
几乎每一个呼吸，他的肉身就会变得更强一个层次。
不知道过去了多久之后。
盘坐在地上的秦玄苏醒过来，睁开双眸，眸绽冷电。
举手投足间，血气滚滚，蕴含着前所未有的强大力量。
甚至乎，这股力量比起当初丹田没有被废掉还要更强得多。
究竟多强，秦玄模糊猜测，至少能有超过八万斤的力量。
要知道，炼体境作为武道第一个大境界，以淬炼体魄为主，一般而言，就算修炼到极致，能达到万斤巨力已经很惊人了。
而他现在重修后，依旧是炼体境，但一身力量却是达到了八万斤。
而且，感觉这还不是他的极限，体内有更强的力量正在源源不断涌现而出。
秦玄为之惊叹，正要询问神秘人，就在这时候，外界的争吵，将他的意识带回去了外界。
……
秦家大门前。
“秦恒，你们可以这样对待玄儿，他可是你们的族兄弟。”

“哈哈，族兄弟？柳姨你可是说错了，我秦家可没有这样的废物家族子弟！”
秦恒哈哈大笑，毫不留情地重重踢出一脚，将昏迷的秦玄踹到了两个女子身前。
其中一白色素裙的美妇人，正是秦玄的娘亲。
当知晓秦玄归来的消息，第一时间出来便出来迎接，却发现这令人心寒的一幕。
看着地上昏迷不醒的秦玄和秦灵儿，美妇人无比心痛地跪在地上，把兄妹二人护在怀里，忍不住心痛落泪：“玄儿为家族付出这么多，你们为什么这样对他？”
“哼，为什么，就凭他是废物！
区区一个废物，也配进入我秦家大门？”
秦恒冷笑，面对美妇人没有半点尊重，倒是狞笑一声，道：“柳姨，倒是现在秦灵儿身受重伤，奄奄一息，需要还神丹方可救治。
作为灵儿的族兄，我倒是有个好建议。
孙家那个残废三少爷素来喜欢灵儿已久，不若将灵儿许配给他，当个小妾，孙家三少爷说不定痴心一片，用彩礼在家主手上换这还神丹，还能勉强活下去。”
“你……”
content_en:
On the first floor of the Burial Tower, there are countless gray mist floating up and down. It is the purest energy of chaos. It is a supreme energy that is much higher than the vitality of heaven and earth cultivated by martial cultivators.
At this moment, being inexplicably drawn, a large amount of chaotic mist rushed towards Qin Xuan's body.
It turned out that because of that battle, Qin Xuan not only had his Dantian destroyed, but also had a lot of broken meridians. He suffered countless hidden injuries all over his body, and even many of his bones had cracks or even breaks.
Generally speaking, if a martial artist suffers such damage, even if his Dantian is not broken, he cannot continue to improve.
Over time, once the potential hidden injury breaks out, it will directly kill the martial artist.
But as the chaotic mist entered the body, all the hidden injuries in Qin Xuan's body were repaired in an instant, including the Dantian.
Moreover, the physical body has undergone unprecedented changes and is constantly being tempered and transformed.
With almost every breath, his body becomes stronger.
I don’t know how much time has passed.
Qin Xuan, who was sitting cross-legged on the ground, woke up, opened his eyes, and his eyes were filled with cold electricity.
Every movement of his hands and feet was full of blood, containing unprecedented power.
In fact, this power is much stronger than when Dantian was not destroyed.
Just how strong it was, Qin Xuan vaguely guessed that it could at least exceed 80,000 kilograms of strength.
You must know that the body refining realm, as the first major realm in martial arts, focuses on tempering the body. Generally speaking, even if you practice to the extreme, it is already amazing to be able to reach tens of thousands of kilograms of strength.
And now that he has re-cultivated, he is still in the body refining state, but his strength has reached 80,000 kilograms.
Moreover, it feels like this is not his limit, and there is stronger power emerging from his body.
Qin Xuan was amazed and was about to ask the mysterious man. At this moment, the quarrel in the outside world brought his consciousness back to the outside world.
…
In front of the Qin family gate.
"Qin Heng, you can treat Xuan'er like this, he is your clan brother."
"Haha, clan brother? Aunt Liu, you are wrong. Our Qin family does not have such a useless child!"
Qin Heng laughed loudly and kicked the unconscious Qin Xuan hard in front of the two women without mercy.
One of the beautiful women in a white plain dress is Qin Xuan's mother.
When he heard the news about Qin Xuan's return, he came out to greet him as soon as possible, only to find this chilling scene.
Looking at Qin Xuan and Qin Ling'er who were unconscious on the ground, the beautiful woman knelt on the ground with great heartache, protecting the two brothers and sisters in her arms. She couldn't help but shed tears: "Xuan'er has paid so much for the family, why do you treat him like this?"
"Humph, why, just because he is a waste!
Is a mere trash worthy of entering the gate of my Qin family? "
Qin Heng sneered, showing no respect for the beautiful woman at all, but he gave a ferocious smile and said: "Aunt Liu, Qin Ling'er is seriously injured now and is dying. He needs to be treated with the magic pill before he can be treated.
As Ling'er's clan brother, I have a good suggestion.
The disabled third young master of the Sun family has always been in love with Ling'er for a long time. If he had not betrothed Ling'er to him as a concubine, the third young master of the Sun family might be so infatuated that he could barely survive by exchanging the betrothal gift for the rejuvenating pill in the hands of the family master. "
"You..."
